mutant.description: FOUR planted mutants, not one, because the four acceptance criteria are supposed to have INDEPENDENT discriminating power and a shared-fate control set cannot show that. (1) `resign` re-signs in_kind_value in place -- the exact design CTO 74187 ruled OUT. (2) `sign` inverts the LONG/SHORT map, leaving the old contract untouched, so ONLY consumer-side controls can catch it. (3) `drop` leaves every IC leg undirected (signed 0.0, flag set). (4) `c02` perturbs one EXTERNAL cash leg's signed_amount by a cent -- planted specifically because C01-4 stays GREEN under the other three and a control never seen to fire is a promise, not a control. A FIFTH control guards the harness's own baseline: BASELINE_COMMIT is repointed at the post-fix commit and the run must REFUSE.
mutant.expected: Every mutant arm exits rc=1. `resign` must fire C01-1 and NOT C01-2; `sign` must fire C01-2 and NOT C01-1 (proving C01-2 is not riding C01-1); `drop` must fire both; `c02` must fire C01-4. The baseline guard must exit non-zero with a message naming the schema version it found.
